en: Changed `sonnet` and background requests on Google Cloud's Agent Platform to read `VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET`; with only the `4_5` variable set they go to `CLOUD_ML_REGION` or `us-east5`
zh: 变更：Google Cloud 的 Agent Platform 上的 `sonnet` 和后台请求改为读取 `VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET`；若仅设置了 `4_5` 变量，则使用 `CLOUD_ML_REGION` 或 `us-east5`
